en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph depicting a coastal scene with waves breaking on the shore and a low rocky promontory. On the promontory, there are buildings partially obscured by trees, some of which are tall conifers. The foreground shows the sea, and the background features a mix of bare and evergreen trees. The overall style and wear of the image suggest an early 20th-century postcard. Greek text is visible on the lower part of the postcard.
